groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C

questions.text: What first attracted Terence to the topic of the sculptures?

options.t: He read several journal articles
He attended an exhibition
He spent some time in Nigeria

questions.text: In his presentation Terence will focus on sculptures featuring

options.t: abstract designs
fish and wild animals
people

questions.text: How did Terence finance his trip to Ife?

options.t: He received money from an arts organisation
His mother and father paid for him
He wrote about the trip for a newspaper

questions.text: What was most memorable for Terence about his trip?

options.t: helping at an archaeological site
the professor he met
the artists he got to know

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E Which TWO additions will Terence make to the part of the presentation on the sculptures?

options.t: enlarged pictures of the sculptures
more material about the subjects
more about his personal opinion of the art works
extra information about the techniques used
additional information about the artists

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E Which TWO additions will Terence make to the section on history?

options.t: data about the kings in the Ife area
extra information about the surrounding region
examination of the beliefs of the Ife people
an explanation of the development of modern Ife
more details of past activities of the Ife people

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A-E Which TWO features of his research in Nigeria will Terence discuss in his presentation?

options.t: the influence of the sculptures on western artists
the uncertainty over who made the sculptures
the sources of the materials used for the sculptures
the problems he faced in collecting information
the original discovery of the sculptures
